str.verbatim_directive: Apply force, endure damage, override resistance, and solve problems through physical action and structural dominance.

dex.verbatim_directive: Maintain precision under instability, act with timing and finesse, and avoid detection or waste through careful motion.

int.verbatim_directive: Analyze systems, optimize processes, override constraints, and enforce outcomes through logic and planning.

entity_description.nature: A planet-scale feedback loop between drill, star-furnace, and sub-crustal anchors.
entity_description.presence: Felt as vibration, heat bloom, gravity shear, and signal distortion rather than a single body.

str.interaction: physically reinforce, brace, crush, or reroute massive components

dex.interaction: synchronize moving systems, dampen oscillations, and act during narrow timing windows

int.interaction: map feedback loops, override automated governors, and reprogram thermal logic

stabilized.description: The furnace enters a controlled burn. The world survives, scarred but operational.

contained.description: The furnace is locked into a reduced-output mode. Long-term instability remains.

breach.description: The anchors fail. The world drifts. Survival continues elsewhere.
